message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can only change your order to one of the following items:

- PIZZA  
- BURGER  
- SALAD  
- SOUP  
- STEAK  

If you’d like to switch to one of those, just let me know which one!

The system says we have a function ChaFod that changes the selection of food based on the customer's request, ensuring the food name provided is in uppercase as per the requirement. The function accepts a parameter TheFod which must be one of "PIZZA" | "BURGER" | "SALAD" | "SOUP" | "STEAK". "Greens" is not in that list. So we cannot fulfill the request. We should explain that we can only change to one of the allowed options. We can ask if they'd like to choose from the available options. So we respond politely.
